title: Frans Hals Museum
scope: The Frans Hals Museum’s principal Hof building at Groot Heiligland 62, Haarlem, with the surviving former almshouse quadrangle, street façade and courtyard-facing wings.
limitations: Models the principal historic museum at its Hof address. The separate Hal and individually mapped adjoining buildings are outside the site model.
The courtyard, grouped shutters, masonry, entry work and varying roofs follow the archive and survey. Fine ornament, roof tile joints and nonprincipal outer walls are representative.
